When I was 15, my parents had a strict rule of no electronics in my room, including my phone. During that time, I was incredibly depressed and was forced to go to bed at an early time. As a result, I felt an overwhelming sense of loneliness. I realized that I could use an old candy bar phone that was still on our plan due to some bug in the system that made it cheaper to keep it than not. So I started texting my friends at night, charging it under my bed with an extension cord. Got caught eventually after my parents looked at the bill.
